complete_fresh_pass.note: Complete fresh census of all 768 tasks, without checkpoint reuse, measured by a separate parent process; private /tmp SQLite working directory.

concurrency_note: The fresh pass initially overlapped resumed verification passes and supplementary read-only checks; measurements are actual observed costs, not an isolated speed comparison.
disk_note: Includes original/restored snapshots, archive, six retained local parts, and three SQLite result databases. Extra workspace synchronization copies caused the separately recorded disk failure; active SQLite moved to /tmp.

interrupted_traversals.reason: Disk exhausted by transient workspace synchronization copies; production and frozen snapshot unchanged.

restored-run.note: Segments include source hash revalidation on resume; intentional hard-crash segment measured separately by supervisor.

run.note: Segments include source hash revalidation on resume; intentional hard-crash segment measured separately by supervisor.

streaming_pass.note: Segments include source hash revalidation on resume; intentional hard-crash segment measured separately by supervisor.
